name: Den bien
summary: Đẻn biển is a small-bodied sea snake. Du khách, the Quảng Trị visitor desk, says cooks stir-fry it with lemongrass and chili, serve it with bánh đa, simmer it as porridge, or mince it into a fried rice-paper roll. It is not the cartilaginous fish at Đá Nhảy.
origin: Quảng Bình. The Đồng Hới ward office names đẻn biển and does not define it. Du khách on 29 May 2024, crediting VCT News, calls it a sea snake, also known as mãng xà biển.
howToEat: Du khách on 29 May 2024 names three plates: đẻn xào sả ớt, đẻn with bánh đa, and cháo đẻn.
Du khách on 13 Mar 2024, republishing Báo Đắc Nông, describes ram đẻn: the snake is cleaned, minced, rolled in rice paper, and fried until crisp.
A street, an hour, and a price were not printed. Check on arrival.
where: A Đồng Hới street was not printed. The ward office names the animal with the city’s seafood. The address is Check on arrival.
